During the Harrowing, the Aegi remember the dead and celebrate the living. It's a time for candy, costumes and tricks! This event features:

- A new event-themed ^cyan;vendor ^reset;who sells a variety of event items. You can find Ayala, the Harrowing event vendor, in the Creon Embassy

- ^cyan;Collectible masks ^reset;and ^cyan;costumes ^reset;for all races

- ^cyan;Sweet candy ^reset;that offers a variety of useful and fun status effects

- New quests for obtaining event-themed ^orange;Unique-quality items^reset;

- Event-themed ^cyan;decorative objects ^reset;to bring the Harrowing to your own home

The Landing Festival, a celebration of the Aegi's arrival on Elithia hundreds of years ago, has arrived! This event features:

- A new location, the ^cyan;Festival Hall^reset;, accessible through a teleporter in the Creon Embassy

- New event-themed ^cyan;decorative objects^reset;, ^cyan;armour pieces^reset;, ^cyan;weapons^reset; and ^cyan;consumables^reset;

- New quests for obtaining event-themed ^orange;Unique-quality items^reset;

- ^cyan;Fireworks^reset; available in various colours

- ^cyan;Daily presents^reset; in the Festival Hall. Visit the large decorated tree in the Festival Hall for a free daily present

- A second chance at obtaining ^cyan;items missed in previous events^reset;. These items drop randomly from Landing Festival Presents!
koreanText:

englishText:
But not long till the Floran chomped and gobbled,
and in her delight, her hunger concerns halted.

And so the Floran journeyed though the ruined city,
from pleasure to fear, Earth's victims moaned and screamed.

The Floran feasted on her so called tentacled victims,
with each bite after another, her appetite grows.
koreanText:
하지만 얼마 지나지 않아 플로란은 우적우적 먹어치웠고,
그 기쁨 속에서, 배고픔에 대한 걱정도 멎었다.

그리하여 플로란은 폐허가 된 도시를 여행했고,
쾌락에서 공포로, 지구의 희생자들은 신음하고 비명을 질렀다.

플로란은 이른바 촉수 달린 희생자들을 포식했고,
한 입 한 입 베어 물 때마다, 그녀의 식욕은 커져만 갔다.
